en.title: Free remove.bg Alternative — Full Resolution, No Upload | Cutova
en.description: Looking for a remove.bg alternative? Cutova removes backgrounds for free at full resolution, with no account and no upload: everything runs in your browser.
en.h1: A free remove.bg alternative that keeps your photos on your device
intro: remove.bg made automatic background removal popular. Cutova does the same job with a different approach: the AI runs inside your browser instead of on a server.
That one change has practical consequences: you download at full resolution for free, you do not need an account, and your photos are never uploaded.

sections.h2: When Cutova is the better choice
paragraphs: Choose Cutova when privacy matters (ID photos, client work, unreleased products), when you need many full-size images without paying per image, or when you simply do not want to create an account.

Because the model runs on your device, speed depends on your hardware. A computer with a recent graphics card handles a photo in a few seconds; an older laptop or a phone takes longer. The first image also downloads the model once.
Quality is very good on people, hair and pets. Transparent glass, handwriting and crowded scenes are harder for any automatic tool, Cutova included.
There is nothing to install and nothing to migrate. Open Cutova, drop the same photo you would have sent to remove.bg, and download the result.

faq.q: Is Cutova a copy of remove.bg?
faq.a: No. Cutova is an independent product built on open-source AI models (MIT and Apache-2.0 licenses). It is not affiliated with remove.bg.

faq.q: Can I use the results commercially?
faq.a: Yes. The images you create are yours, and the models Cutova uses are published under licenses that allow commercial use.

faq.q: Is there an API like remove.bg?
faq.a: Not yet. An API is planned. For now, Cutova is a web app that works one image at a time.
